newsitem.title: USA: Money Store sees delinquencies within range.
newsitem.headline: Money Store sees delinquencies within range.

text.p: Money Store Inc said Wednesday it is comfortable delinquencies will stay within its overall target for the year, even though that rate rose faster than expected in the first quarter.

The company said that compared to the levels at December 31, thirty day-and-over delinquencies as of March 31 increased 64 basis points to 6.59 percent of home equity loans, 58 basis points to 6.47 percent of commercial loans, and 40 basis points to 3.43 percent of auto loans.
The company said charge-offs and delinquencies are "within manageable ranges," and it is is building its credit loss reserve.
The company said at the end of the first quarter, its allowance for credit losses as a percentage was at its highest in its history.
